what: Big text and image bands slide left by that distance × speed while they enter from the bottom of the screen and exit at the top (during a scroll of screen height + band height). Scrub 1 (follows 1s late), no curve. ”WE ARE ○○” hand-drawn slogan band. With multiple bands and per-row direction and start position, tilted photo rows become bands flowing in opposite directions (brand: four −15° rows, .025% of width per 1px).

options.speed: Drag ratio (horizontal px per 1px vertical), default 1 (Brand .8)
options.scrub: Follow lag (seconds), default 1 — 0 means no lag, sticking directly to scroll
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Pushed strip — make it comfortably longer than the plate (same image two or three times). With several, data-dir on each strip="1"(Right, default −1 is left) · data-offset="-50"(First position)
options.unit: “%” reads speed as a percentage of the band width per 1px vertical (city .025) — default is px
options.sp: Speed used at 834px width and below, default same as speed (City .015)
options.span: together with unit: % — fixes the amount shifted during the pass at this much (%) of the strip width regardless of scroll distance (Site 10: start position → ±10%)
options.narrow: Multiplier applied to initial position and span at widths below bp, default 1 (brand .5)
options.bp: Width (px) at which narrow is used, default 834 (brand 559)

from.where: index.html and detail.html .tb-weare. Original common.js tbss: gsap.to(track, x: −(innerHeight + panel height) × data-slidespeed(.8)), start top bottom · end bottom top · scrub 1

index.html .biz (business band where four tilted photo rows flow in opposite directions) — original top.js: translate(progress px × .025 (phone .015) × dir + offset %), rows one and three start at left 0, rows two and four start at right −50%, no lag
from.options: unit: %; speed: .025; sp: .015; scrub: 0 — data-dir·data-offset per band

from.where: index.html .hm-deco three WE ARE ○○ lines — original deco: lines 1 and 3 xPercent 5→−5, line 2 10→20 (half of that below 560) scrub true → unit: %; span: 10; narrow: .5; bp: 559; scrub: 0, per line data-offset 5·10 · data-dir −1·1
